source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: After deployment, alternate resolving eligible redeployments, with the Attacker going first. If a rule lets a redeploying unit enter **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**, leave it out of the **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** points total unless that rule says otherwise.

detail.strategicReservesCap: units placed by redeployment exempt unless specified otherwise
